title: Terraform guardrails + CI pipeline for Private VPC stacks and health checks
creator: Marta Gonzalez
description: Add a production-ready CI pipeline and guardrails for Terraform modules that manage Private (VPC) deployments. Goals: 1) Linting and static checks for Terraform HCL and module inputs; 2) Gateable plan review step that enforces policy-as-code (RegO/Conftest & OPA) and prevents unsafe network changes; 3) Automated apply path for approved changes with a separate auditable runner for sensitive stacks; 4) Post-apply health checks to validate networking, service endpoints, and KV cache reachability; 5) Canary upgrade/testing for module version upgrades to avoid global disruption. This ticket covers pipeline orchestration, Conftest/OPA policy authoring for VPC/network rules, integration with Slack approvals and the Console audit log, and adding a health-check job that runs smoke tests after apply and reports to the observability dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: CI pipeline runs lint and fmt checks on all terraform HCL in terraform/private/**
Plan stage fails when any Conftest/OPA policy rules are violated (network exposure, public subnets for private stacks, missing tags, KMS not configured)
Plan output is persisted as an artifact and can be reviewed in the merge request with a generated summary of changed resources
Apply requires a two-step approval for stacks tagged "sensitive" and uses a dedicated runner with restricted credentials
Post-apply health-check stage runs: subnet/cidr reachability, service endpoint probe, DNS resolution, and application-level smoke test; failures trigger rollback or manual mitigation runbook
Module upgrade flows include a dry-run test environment and automated compatibility checks before auto-promoting to production
Pipeline emits structured events to the Console audit stream and links back to the PR and Terraform state change ID
tasks: Draft CI pipeline (GitHub Actions) with stages: fmt -> validate -> plan (artifact) -> policy -> approval -> apply -> post-apply-health-check
Create Conftest policies (rego) for network/VPC guardrails and add unit tests for policies
Add Terraform fmt/validate linting to pre-commit and CI
Implement 'gateable plan' storage and a MR comment summarizer bot
Provision a restricted CI runner for sensitive applies and document credential rotation
Implement post-apply health-check script (bash/python) and integrate with observability job that pushes results to Console
Write runbooks for failed health checks and automated rollback criteria
Add module upgrade job that spins up ephemeral test env, runs smoke tests, and reports metric diffs

reviewer_feedback: Samir Patel (SRE): prefer separate non-blocking job that continuously validates long-lived private stacks for drift; do not overload the apply path
Leah Chen (Security): require CRL check for certs in network endpoints and confirm KMS key policies before apply; mark as security_review_required
Priya Nair (PM): Make approval UX low-friction for infra engineers; include a 'why' summary and quick revert instructions in MR comments
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Blocking applies for benign changes because policies are too strict. Mitigation: add policy severity levels and an operator bypass audit path with required approvals
Risk: Credential leakage from shared runners. Mitigation: dedicated runner for sensitive stacks, short-lived tokens, and KMS-based secret retrieval
Risk: Health-check false positives during transient infra changes. Mitigation: implement retry/backoff and require N consecutive failures before rollback
Risk: Module upgrade causing cascading failures. Mitigation: run upgrades in isolated test envs with smoke tests and gradual promotion
additional_notes: Plan to coordinate with the Dedicated infra team for runner capacity and with Security for final policy sign-off
Propose a follow-up ticket for continuous drift detection and scheduled health-check sweeping (non-blocking)
